entries.28e6a8b62cd94f52: Building and Selling Housing and Real Estate
entries.3102370904a60238: This industry takes on work to build buildings, roads, bridges, tunnels and more.
entries.39939e5d0f35f2c6: This is the stage that makes and sells the materials, parts and housing equipment used in buildings.
entries.3a363700a6c617f1: This is the stage that plans, builds and sells housing and real estate.
entries.3cb2d7723434d5e7: Supplies prime movers, boilers and energy plants to electric power companies, gas companies and others.
entries.481d4a8570d8423a: Receives orders from real estate companies for construction work on condominiums and similar buildings, and for housing building materials.
entries.5982b1e4de02cb11: This is the field that supports construction by making machinery and temporary equipment used at construction sites.
entries.5fc4d3a7509093e2: Sells industrial friction materials, vehicle interior materials, automotive glass, and industrial machinery such as presses to automakers and automotive parts manufacturers.
entries.6053d6fe62048320: This is the stage that takes on building and civil engineering work.
entries.7cfa6d2920562160: Sells semiconductor-related components and semiconductor materials to the semiconductor field.
entries.89c687aecc7b5a95: This industry takes on work to build buildings, roads, bridges, tunnels and more. It also includes companies that make the building materials, housing equipment and construction machinery used in that work. Some companies sell or manage completed housing and real estate.
entries.8a01391495a04df5: This is the stage that takes on building and civil engineering work. It includes building construction such as office buildings and civil engineering such as bridges and tunnels, as well as specialized work such as air-conditioning and plumbing installation and roof reinforcement. Some companies also carry out design and seismic assessments.
entries.ad0c7b13e8b495a2: This is the stage that plans, builds and sells housing and real estate. It includes contract construction and sale of detached houses and condominiums, construction of rental housing, and development of office buildings.
entries.b7bcd3bc33c4c363: Receives orders for construction work from railway companies and others.
entries.ca8a1d858046e4e9: Sells housing-related water-related products and building materials to chemical companies that have a housing business.
entries.ce702f4cfe3dfc9e: This is the stage that makes and sells the materials, parts and housing equipment used in buildings. Examples include noncombustible building materials, sashes and doors, water-related products, decorative panels, plate glass and piping. Some companies that sell tiles and similar products also carry out the installation work.
entries.daeb1ba53c95fc96: This is the stage that manages and operates completed buildings and housing. It includes leasing and managing rental housing, managing condominiums for sale, and building maintenance.
entries.f0f691cc9e9369c1: Taking On Design and Construction Work
entries.f24e455f7676cd20: This is the stage that manages and operates completed buildings and housing.
entries.fcb0eb8cfcea2242: This is the field that supports construction by making machinery and temporary equipment used at construction sites. It includes construction machinery such as hydraulic excavators, scaffolding, and engine compressors and generators. Some companies not only make this equipment but also rent it out.
